name: How do you handle existing foundation moisture before finishing a basement?

mainEntity.name: How do you handle existing foundation moisture before finishing a basement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Address all water concerns before starting custom carpentry, framing, or drywall work. HH Remodeling inspects perimeter foundation walls and floor slabs for signs of efflorescence, seepage, or past leaks during initial planning. Correcting exterior grading, ensuring gutters drain away from the foundation, and verifying that sump pumps work properly are critical preliminary steps. Installing moisture-resistant materials and proper vapor barriers behind framing protects your basement design from future damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Moisture issues must be resolved before framing begins through exterior drainage checks, sump pumps, and moisture barriers behind new walls.
